Lampard on team news, Man City verdict and Jaissle

Figure caption,

By Tasnim Chowdhury
BBC Sport journalist

Published

8 October 2026

Coventry boss Frank Lampard has been speaking to the media before Monday's Premier League game against Newcastle United at CBS Arena (kick-off 20:00 BST).

Here are the key lines from his news conference or you can listen to him speak on BBC CWR:

Lampard said there are no injury concerns for the players returning from international duty. Defenders Milan van Ewijk and Kaine Kesler-Hayden have returned to training.
